note: Machine-readable transcription of the owner's answers; owner_answer_verbatim is copied character-for-character from the pinned source file. classification_by_recorder is a convenience index, not part of the decision; the verbatim text governs.

answers.question: Obtain the RFP document (defproc / tdf.drdo.gov.in need a human for the captcha / are 503).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — obtain the canonical latest RFP PDF immediately through the legitimate owner/portal route; store the exact file, source URL/date and SHA-256. Do not freeze ambiguous RFP interpretations from secondary sources.

answers.question: Confirm RFP number (XI/LM vs X/L/M) and bid close date (05 Oct vs 20 Oct 2026).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: VERIFY-FIRST — use Tender ID `2026_DRDO_788433_1` for project tracking. Do not choose 05 Oct vs 20 Oct, or XI/LM vs X/L/M, from conflicting secondary material; freeze the exact RFP reference and bid-close date only from the official tender/RFP copy.

answers.question: Mission life: 26,000 h (repo) vs 'three years' = 26,280 h (news); and is '> 15,000 h firing' in the RFP?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ENGINEERING BASIS — use mission life ≥26,280 h until the official wording is verified because it is the conservative interpretation of 'three years' versus 26,000 h. Retain >15,000 h firing as a provisional hard requirement until the official RFP confirms it.

answers.question: Meaning of '12-25 mN'.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: AMEND option (ii) — plan for ≥12 mN sustained atmospheric operation and demonstrated 25 mN system capability. Do not require Xe specifically for 25 mN; Xe may be used if the RFP permits and must then be explicitly booked. The 25 mN point must still satisfy the full-system power gate.

answers.question: Does the 40 kg include the Xe load (and tank)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: INCLUDES Xe + tank — use the conservative wet-system interpretation unless the official RFP explicitly defines the 40 kg as dry mass.

answers.question: Does 'air + Xe' / 'supplemented with Xenon' require Xe-mode operation beyond ignition, cathode and contingency?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES, bounded functional Xe mode — treat 'supplementary/alternative Xenon' as requiring a demonstrated Xe-capable operating mode beyond mere bookkeeping. It need not be continuous nominal operation; book every Xe use explicitly.

answers.question: Authorize legitimate acquisition (library / ILL / purchase / owner channel) of: Li 2015 (compressor CR), Tejeda & Knoll 2023, Bayliss & Knoll IEPC-2025, Cifali 2012, Wang 1995, blocked datasheets (Combat BN, C-1 candidates).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — authorize lawful library/ILL/purchase/owner-channel acquisition of all listed items. Add the Takahashi/Watanabe 2024 Hall + downstream RF-ICP paper and any primary RF-plasma-cathode papers. No access bypasses or author-contact shortcuts unless separately authorized.

answers.question: Request supplier quotations at all (Xe tank 5-20 L, low-flow PMU/FCU, MFCs, thrust stand)? This means contacting suppliers.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES, quotations only now — request quotations for Xe tank/PMU/FCU/MFCs/thrust stand and add 13.56 MHz RF generator, matching network, directional coupler, RF feedthroughs and ICP chamber components. No purchase order until H3/A9 interfaces are frozen.

answers.question: Merge the H2 hardware wave (H2-1..H2-7, all verified; on claude/nifty-ramanujan-w68f9z) into main via a new PR?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NOT YET — do not direct-merge. First create a checkpoint PR from the execution branch, freeze new merges briefly, run full pytest + golden + integrity + GitHub CI, review the diff, then merge if green.

answers.question: Delete 8 leftover worktrees from failed runs (uncommitted partial edits, all superseded)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: DELETE after preservation check — first save a patch/diff or archive any unique uncommitted material, verify each worktree is superseded, then remove all eight.

answers.question: Parallel RF||Hall v2 branch (feature/rf-hall-parallel-v2, 7335dcd, reviewed): merge, open a PR, or keep as a branch?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: KEEP AS BRANCH — do not merge the parallel RF∥Hall v2 branch. Preserve it as an alternative/historical hypothesis; the primary investigation is now Hall → downstream RF/ICP neutralizer.

answers.question: Split of the ln R_arch uncertainty budget over variance groups G1-G5.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED for the primary campaign. Preserve historical D-01-A if the old pre-ionizer experiment is ever resumed. Create a new uncertainty budget for the C1-vs-ICP neutralizer comparison.

answers.question: Arm stop rule D3.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED for the primary campaign. Preserve historical D-02-A only for the old experiment; define new stop rules before any Hall→ICP score-bearing data.

answers.question: Must a stop from the confirmation subset rest on Hall-on data at P_lo too?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED for the primary campaign. If the historical campaign is resumed, retain D-03-B; otherwise no new work.

answers.question: Iso-power chord error u_interp.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: HISTORICAL D-04-B if reused. For Hall→ICP, prefer measured midpoint/iso-power points over interpolation wherever practical; any interpolation uncertainty must be preregistered.

answers.question: Where the signed LOCK-1/LOCK-2 files live.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: KEEP historical LOCK files in `experiment_protocol/prereg`; create a separate versioned Hall→ICP preregistration path, e.g. `docs/experiments/hall_icp/prereg/`. Never overwrite the old locks.

answers.question: How HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR are realized on H-1; and configuration change = swap module only (H-1 stays on stand) or re-mount H-1 each time.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: REPLACE old HW-0/HW-RF/HW-ECR scheme for the primary campaign. Keep H-1 fixed on the stand and swap only the downstream electron-source module: conventional Xe-fed C1 reference vs downstream 13.56 MHz ICP neutralizer, with matched sham services/fixtures.

answers.question: Decision margin delta on ln R_arch, and whether effect size is a LOCK-1 rule or a LOCK-2 value (A6 forbids numeric Phase-1 thresholds now).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED numeric delta — do not carry 0.05/0.1 into the new architecture automatically. Define the new decision quantities first, then freeze any effect-size margin before score-bearing data.

answers.question: Admissible block counts n (n computed at LOCK-2); must n be whole replicates of the 6 sequences?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NEW CAMPAIGN RULE — use complete balanced replicate sets; minimum three complete engineering replicates, with final n determined at LOCK-2 from measured uncertainty. Preserve old D-08 only as historical.

answers.question: Tested Hall unit H-1: Vyovrinda design or a surrogate; definition of 'design-representative'.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: D-09-A — use the actual Vyovrinda H-1 design-representative unit. A surrogate may be used only as non-scoring shakedown hardware.

answers.question: Adopt a single protocol basis (lane 25 + lane 06 reconciliation)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: D-10-A — adopt one reconciled protocol basis. Do not run competing protocol definitions against the same score-bearing campaign.

answers.question: Unmeasured common loads (compressor bus draw, valve-outlet feed state).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: D-11-A — report `PARTIAL_BOUNDARY` until compressor bus draw and valve-outlet feed state are measured/provided by ICD. Do not insert guessed fixed loads.

answers.question: Facility requirements per stage, T-PB-MAX (max background pressure), number of elevated p_b levels; fallback if ~1e-5 Torr at 3.2 mg/s (~212,000 L/s N2) is unreachable - accept 5e-5 Torr (~42,000 L/s) with the S5 slope reported?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: B — use two elevated background-pressure levels for facility-effect characterization. Freeze T-PB-MAX only after the low-flow knee and facility capability are known. 5e-5 Torr may be used for engineering characterization, but not silently substituted for a stricter score-bearing requirement.

answers.question: Measure ignition / start attempts per arm (Xe-assisted and air-only)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: B — add ignition/start attempts. For Hall→ICP, also record ICP ignition, Hall ignition with ICP electrons, restart success and cycle count; classify them per preregistration rather than hiding them as setup events.

answers.question: Physics track pre-registers part of the new data as held-out Hall-transport validation?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: B — yes, preregister a held-out subset for Hall-transport validation before S1. No data reclassification after exposure.

answers.question: Scope extensions: Xe health check; Xe-augmented peak points (labelled XE_AUGMENTED_PEAK, never Case A evidence, Xe booked to the Xe ledger).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: RETAIN the useful parts of D-15-C — perform a Xe health/reference check and bounded Xe peak points if permitted by the RFP. Label them explicitly and never use them as evidence for atmospheric-only performance.

answers.question: Absolute gate: must 25 mN capability be shown within P_bus < 1.5 kW, or only sustained 12 mN?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: 25 mN — demonstrate 25 mN capability inside the same full spacecraft-DC propulsion boundary with P_bus <1.5 kW. 16.67 mN/kW is the absolute full-system floor at that point.

answers.question: Accept the Phase-1 decision topology (cases A hall_only / B rf_hall / C ecr_hall / NO_VIABLE_CASE via P1DQ decision quantities)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — do not execute the old hall_only / rf_hall / ecr_hall topology as the primary Phase-1 decision. New primary comparison: conventional Hall + Xe-fed C1 vs Hall + downstream RF/ICP neutralizer vs `NO_VIABLE_CASE`; retain old framework as historical.

answers.question: Configuration order: order-balanced design governs; old HW-0-first/last become reference checks?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT — order-balanced design governs. Reference checks remain reference checks, not a substitute for balancing.

answers.question: Randomization seed timing.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Draw the randomization seed at LOCK-2 after n is fixed. At LOCK-1 freeze the seed-generation procedure; at LOCK-2 publish the actual seed and hash before execution.

answers.question: Condition grid fixed at LOCK-1 from W1 + anticipated knee; knee is an output per configuration?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT — freeze the condition grid at LOCK-1 from W1 plus the anticipated knee. Treat the knee location as an output for each configuration.

answers.question: eta_u has no S1b repeatability.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADD repeatability — if eta_u/beam current is used in any decision quantity, include Faraday/ExB repeatability at S1b. Descriptive-only eta_u is insufficient for a gating comparison.

answers.question: Add RR-07 module-exchange remount check (RF/ECR install reproducibility)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — add RR-07, adapted to C1 ↔ ICP-neutralizer module exchange. H-1 remains fixed.

answers.question: Confirm mapping: A5 'Phase 1' spans pivot Phase-1 knee, Phase-2 comparison and Phase-3 absolute gates.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED for new work — retain the old A5 meaning historically, but create a separate Hall→ICP campaign stage map rather than stretching A5 terminology.

answers.question: W5 class of HW0-REF readings.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: HELD-OUT custody until W5 decides; no exposure-driven reclassification.

answers.question: Within-installation gas order.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use an Ar engineering-only replication first to reproduce the Takahashi-type topology, then pure N2, then O2-bearing mixtures last; keep the Xe reference per the bounded Xe plan. Ar data do not satisfy DRDO atmospheric requirements.

answers.question: Form of the Case B net system-level benefit where both sustain.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NEW `NET_BENEFIT` form — hard gates + Pareto, not a weighted score. ICP must meet electron-current/neutralization, thrust, full P_bus, stability and safety gates; then report ΔXe, ΔP_bus, Δmass, T/P_bus, restart and life burden relative to C1. No single scalar winner unless preregistered.

answers.question: Evidence that establishes no outcome.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: `OPEN` is a status, not an outcome. If evidence cannot decide, report unresolved and identify the next discriminating test.

answers.question: An arm stop breaks schedule balance.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT — if an arm/configuration stops, mark its scheduled slots `NOT_TESTED`, keep all remaining order fixed, and report the balance loss.

answers.question: Reference condition REF-COND (S1b re-mount point: nominal flow/voltage, N2): own installation per block, or merged into adjacent HW-0 (REF-MERGED)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: OWN installation per block — do not merge REF-COND into an adjacent configuration unless a later preregistered equivalence test supports that change.

answers.question: MD-04: abort on a thruster/configuration limit = 'not sustained within limits' (reported with the limit)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — abort/limit hit = `not sustained within registered limits`, with the exact limit and state recorded.

answers.question: Xe accounting convention; is Xe flowing during cathode preheat booked?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: `PHASE_TOTAL_FLOW` — book all Xe during purge, preheat, ignition, keeper/cathode operation, transition and fallback. No unbooked preheat flow.

answers.question: Reserve policy (form and value).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use a separate reserve term equal to 20% of planned non-reserve mission Xe as a provisional engineering allocation. Mark it `ASSUMED_ENGINEERING_ALLOCATION` and revisit after the mission mode profile is measured.

answers.question: Share of the mass reference the stored-Xe subsystem may take.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: 0.25 only as a screening cap, not an entitlement. It must not force the design to consume 25% of the total mass on Xe hardware/propellant.

answers.question: 2 % residual (unusable) Xe: separate line in the Xe ledger, keep in mass BOM only, or fold into reserve?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Separate Xe-ledger line — book the 2% unusable/residual Xe once in the Xe ledger and import that total into the mass BOM. Never add a second residual in the BOM.

answers.question: Firing-hours basis of the cathode term.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: 15,000 h for the conventional C1 reference/fallback term. The ICP-neutralizer architecture has no continuous C1-Xe cathode term, but must carry its own RF-neutralizer lifetime/cycle requirement.

answers.question: Xe hardware-to-mass-BOM mapping (regulator/valves/plumbing -> xe_valve_and_flow_control, tank -> xe_tank).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT for the C1/Xe branch; add separate ICP-neutralizer/RF-electronics BOM items rather than mapping them into the old cathode line.

answers.question: Declare a mission Xe load (design input).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: DO NOT freeze one mission Xe load yet. Run explicit 2 kg / 5 kg / 10 kg design cases for tank/interface sizing; freeze the mission load only after the required Xe operating modes and duty cycle are established.

answers.question: C-1 heated or heaterless (heaterless per-start Xe 2-6x higher)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: HEATED C1 — use a heated Xe-fed LaB6 cathode for the conventional reference/fallback because it minimizes low-flow uncertainty and avoids the heaterless high-start-flow penalty. It is not automatically the final flight neutralizer.

answers.question: Tank sizing at a stated maximum storage temperature (1.67 g/cm3 at 323 K / 150 bar vs 1.97 at 300 K)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Size at the stated maximum storage temperature of 323 K, using a verified Xe EOS and MEOP/safety factors. Do not size the flight tank from room-temperature density alone.

answers.question: Filter-getter (<= 17 W) in the Xe cathode line in scope?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES if the C1/Xe branch remains in scope — include the filter/getter with explicit ≤17 W-class load only after vendor/spec verification; account its mass and pressure drop. It is not required for an ICP-only flight branch.

answers.question: System mass margin.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: 20% internal development/system margin for design work; the hard external gate remains <40 kg wet. If the RFP later specifies a lower accounting margin, retain 20% internally until maturity justifies reducing it.

answers.question: Evaluate the allocation at both ends of '<= 34-36 kg', or fix one value?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: BOTH — evaluate 34 kg and 36 kg internal design allocations and keep 40 kg as the hard wet-system limit.

answers.question: Set per-row mass allocations now (e.g. PPU, regulator) so H2-3/H2-4 size against a budget? (High analog case exceeds 40 kg on known lines.)
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — use a v0 dry-mass budget against a 28 kg dry target: intake/filter/duct 3.5 kg; compressor+drive 5.5; plenum/feed 1.0; Hall head+magnet 3.0; ICP neutralizer 2.0; RF generator/matching 1.5; Hall PPU 2.5; Xe hardware 1.5; controls/harness 1.0; structure/thermal 2.5. Sum 24 kg, leaving 4 kg dry development reserve. These are allocations, not CBEs.

answers.question: Redundancy policy for valves, cathode and PPU.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: LIMITED redundancy — dual series isolation on the high-pressure Xe path plus critical sensing/FDIR redundancy; do not duplicate the thruster, ICP neutralizer or full PPU at this stage. Revisit after failure-tree evidence.

answers.question: Accept NASA SBIR 2 kg PPU development target (undemonstrated) as PPU low end until H2-4 has a CBE?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NO as a CBE — NASA SBIR 2 kg PPU may remain an aspirational/screening low end only. It cannot be used as demonstrated mass evidence.

answers.question: Maturity category for dry equipment.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: PER SELECTED PART — use actual maturity/heritage where known; default new/unselected hardware to ECSS-D-like 20% equipment margin.

answers.question: Legacy uncited MGA dict in abep_sim/mass_bom.py.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: RETIRE only from the new v2/A9 path; preserve the legacy uncited MGA implementation and its goldens for historical reproducibility. New models must use the evidence-controlled margin policy.

answers.question: Mass BOM item list.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT with A9 amendment — add downstream ICP neutralizer, RF generator/matching/feedthrough and collector/bias hardware; retain C1 as reference/fallback. Remove pre-ionizer-only items from the new architecture BOM, not from historical v1.

answers.question: Harness allocation.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: 5% of nominal dry mass until a designed harness exists; replace the allocation with actual routed harness mass once available.

answers.question: Size the common module envelope to the largest occupant (ECR with magnet/yoke/feed)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — do not size a pre-ionizer common envelope around ECR. Create a dedicated downstream ICP-neutralizer mechanical/electrical/plume interface.

answers.question: Common control harness L1-L5 incl. MODULE_ID and blank-module termination?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED old L1-L5 definition. New ICP harness must include module ID, RF forward/reflected power, RF interlock, collector/bias V/I, temperatures and command/telemetry; blank/reference termination only where the new comparison requires it.

answers.question: Pressure-drop class definition, matched passive inserts for the blank module if needed?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — no matched upstream pre-ionizer blank. Define and measure the downstream Hall-exhaust-to-ICP pressure/conductance interface; use a matched mechanical sham only for stand parasitics.

answers.question: Add S1a no-plasma module-exchange series for RF/ECR modules (cold flow, zero/tare, B(z))?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — replace RF/ECR pre-ionizer exchange with C1↔ICP neutralizer exchange checks: cold/tare, service-line parasitic, B(z) perturbation, electrical isolation and RF pickup.

answers.question: Time-matched Xe hold in the HW-0 start equal to the pre-ionizer dwell?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — no pre-ionizer dwell matching. Any C1-vs-ICP comparison must instead preregister equivalent startup-state and thermal-state handling.

answers.question: Module loads with no bus-power slot (RF assist magnet, powered interstage, coolant pump).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NEW BUS-BOUNDARY VERSION — do not prohibit legitimate loads. Add explicit components for RF source/matching, collector/bias supply, any assist magnet and active cooling if used.

answers.question: INV-B3 tolerance on module-induced field change; add coil-current sensitivity scan S_B to LOCK-1?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — add a measured B(z) perturbation/sensitivity scan with the downstream ICP module installed/energized. Freeze an allowable field-change tolerance from measured H-1 sensitivity before score-bearing comparison; do not invent a tolerance now.

answers.question: ECR magnet type.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — ECR is not the primary architecture. Preserve the historical ECR decision only in old files.

answers.question: RF module magnetization.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: UNMAGNETIZED 13.56 MHz ICP for v1/A9 first build. If magnetic assistance is later justified, treat it as a new controlled variant and book its power/mass explicitly.

answers.question: Electrical potential of module body / interstage electrode.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: OLD options are not adequate. Keep the ICP dielectric/body floating unless the validated circuit requires otherwise; control and measure the electron-extraction collector bias separately. Do not hard-ground the plasma body by default.

answers.question: Freeze module interfaces before Phase 1 even if modules arrive later?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — freeze the new downstream ICP mechanical, RF, electrical, gas/plume and diagnostic interfaces before score-bearing Phase 1.

answers.question: RF/ECR: select frequency and P_hi (to specify INS-03 sensors); accept calorimetric load-plane method if inline sensors can't reach u_src?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: 13.56 MHz. Size laboratory RF source and inline measurement chain for 0–500 W forward power initially, with directional-coupler forward/reflected measurements. Calorimetry is an independent cross-check, not the sole primary power measurement.

answers.question: Design flow for channel sizing (delivered flow 0.38-1.29 mg/s design case up to ~3.2 mg/s): where to match channel neutral density?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Match H-1 nominal channel neutral-density sizing around ~1.3 mg/s delivered atmospheric flow, while requiring operability/thermal characterization from ~0.38 mg/s through ~3.2 mg/s. Do not claim the entire range as flight-qualified until measured.

answers.question: Keep magnetically shielded topology (T2) as H-1 baseline, with a replaceable unshielded (T1) pole set?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — magnetically shielded topology T2 as H-1 baseline; an unshielded pole set may be used only as an engineering comparison, not silently as the score-bearing article.

answers.question: L/h upper bound (12 proposed); allow an adjustable-anode development insert before S1?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Accept L/h ≤12. Allow an adjustable-anode development insert only before score-bearing S1; freeze the final anode position/geometry before S1 data.

answers.question: Pole/core material grade (e.g. Hiperco 50 / FeCo-2V inner, pure iron outer, or 430F) and a max-use pole temperature below Curie set from B_sat(T).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT FeCo-2V inner + pure-iron outer as the H-1 engineering baseline. Derive the hot-use limit from sourced B_sat(T)/material data and keep at least the project thermal margin below the qualified limit.

answers.question: Coil insulation family / IEC 60085 class (ceramic Ni-clad Cu vs polyimide), hot-spot margin; accept ~150 V AC turn rating and Ni ferromagnetism if ceramic; decide before or at LOCK-1?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: CERAMIC-insulated copper baseline for the hot/vacuum development coil; avoid polyimide as the primary hot/AO-adjacent solution. If Ni-clad wire is used, measure its magnetic perturbation. Treat 150 V AC turn rating as a minimum procurement screen, subject to representative-gas hipot qualification.

answers.question: MC-1: electromagnet only (traceable B(z) vs current) or permanent-magnet assisted?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: EM ONLY for H-1 — this preserves traceable B(z)-versus-current control and sensitivity sweeps. Flight PM assistance can be evaluated later without contaminating H-1 validation.

answers.question: Cathode location: central (L-CENTRAL; constrains mean diameter) or external (L-EXTERNAL)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: EXTERNAL C1 reference. Do not constrain the H-1 mean diameter around a central C1. Provide a downstream/coaxial interface for the ICP neutralizer and keep the Hall head neutralizer-agnostic.

answers.question: Proposed design factors: B headroom 1.5, working flux 0.7 B_sat, discharge share >= 0.5.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT B-headroom 1.5, working flux 0.7 B_sat and discharge-share ≥0.5 as design factors, clearly tagged as engineering factors until verified.

answers.question: Rate H-1, C-1, supply and isolator to the relaxed 350 V V_d end?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — rate H-1, C1 reference, discharge supply, isolation and diagnostics to the relaxed 350 V end plus appropriate transient/qualification margin.

answers.question: Hot-state B reference sensor on MC-1?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — install a hot-state B reference sensor/measurement provision and preserve traceability to current and temperature.

answers.question: Spares policy: replaced/repaired H-1 or C-1 = new unit with new HW-0 reference and S1b?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — repaired/replaced H-1, C1 or ICP score-bearing module becomes a new serialized unit and requires a new reference/reinstallation sequence before score-bearing use.

answers.question: Accept a high-emittance temperature-capable exterior coating on MC-1 as a baseline requirement (bare metal is design-driving)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES, conditional on vacuum/AO/electrical compatibility — use a high-emittance temperature-capable exterior coating as a baseline thermal requirement and qualify it.

answers.question: Spacecraft thermal ICD: mounting-interface temperature and allowable heat into the spacecraft.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Do not freeze one spacecraft sink number yet. Carry 20/40/60 °C mounting-interface cases and 25/50/100 W allowable conducted-heat cases in the model; freeze the actual ICD value at spacecraft/PDR interface definition.

answers.question: Thermal design margins below each limit (not in the RFP); apply a margin to the ~900 degC BN wall guide (current worst margin only 11.2 K)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Require ≥50 K margin below each validated continuous-use material/insulation temperature limit plus 20% heat-load design margin. The current ~11.2 K BN-wall margin is not acceptable as a design closure.

answers.question: Anode thermal design target (none sourced).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NO unsourced fixed anode temperature target. Derive the allowable temperature from the selected anode material's oxidation/electrical/creep data and design for ≥50 K margin to its validated continuous-use limit.

answers.question: Confirm Xe-fed LaB6 hollow cathode and its emission rating vs derived I_d bound + keeper + interstage currents.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: CONFIRM C1 only as the conventional reference/fallback: heated Xe-fed LaB6 hollow cathode sized to the measured/derived current demand. It is not the primary flight neutralizer if the downstream ICP succeeds.

answers.question: Require pulsed keeper ignition capability (300-600 V) in the supply?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — provide current-limited pulsed keeper ignition capability in the 300–600 V class for C1 development/reference testing, with interlocks and recorded pulse energy.

answers.question: Two isolation valves in series on the flight cathode branch?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — two independent isolation valves in series on the flight high-pressure Xe/cathode branch.

answers.question: Resistor value / switching for the cathode-common tie to ground / spacecraft common.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: DO NOT freeze a resistor value yet. Use an isolated, selectable cathode-common/bleeder topology with voltage/current measurement; choose the final value/switching after EMC and discharge-stability bench tests.

answers.question: Flow step and stopping rule for the spot-mode minimum-flow search.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT 0.005 mg/s flow-step resolution for the C1 spot-mode minimum-flow search, with preregistered stopping criteria.

answers.question: Purge flow/duration before heating and bound on the ignition-flow dwell (unbounded analog reaches ~21 kg Xe at heavy-restart scenario).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use the selected cathode vendor/design-qualified purge and ignition flow; cap each ignition dwell at 120 s and allow at most two retries in the preliminary protocol, then freeze the final bound before score-bearing C1 testing. Book all Xe.

answers.question: Keeper material given O-chemistry: graphite or O-resistant alternative?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Do not use graphite as the flight baseline for an O/AO-exposed keeper. Screen refractory/oxygen-resistant or ceramic-shielded alternatives with biased exposure coupons; freeze material only after erosion/oxidation evidence.

answers.question: Emitter temperature floor 1843 K during O-bearing operation?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT 1843 K as the conservative C1 O-bearing experimental floor pending hardware evidence; do not present it as a demonstrated lifetime solution.

answers.question: Accept conservative +-2 % FS flow class (4.0 % at 0.10 mg/s, 0.216 kg Xe over 15,000 h) as the Xe-ledger flow term until S1a shows the standard class on Xe?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT the conservative ±2% FS class and its Xe-ledger uncertainty term until S1a demonstrates a better calibrated class on Xe.

answers.question: Adopt per-block installed zero check and a declared MFC body-temperature band as a test rule?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT installed zero check per block and a declared MFC body-temperature band.

answers.question: Adopt resolution requirement <= 0.0005 mg/s and digital setpoint for the cathode MFC?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT resolution ≤0.0005 mg/s and digital setpoint for the low-flow cathode MFC.

answers.question: Heated emitter witness near C-1 (metered heater load) or ground-only heated-emitter exposure?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: GROUND-ONLY heated-emitter exposure for material/life work. Near C1 use passive/low-perturbation witnesses; do not add an extra heated emitter into the score-bearing plume unless separately preregistered.

answers.question: Metering-valve control strategy.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: CARRY BOTH strategies until the measured compressor outlet characteristic exists. Freeze the control strategy only after that evidence.

answers.question: Adopt +-5 % / 10 % p-p cold-flow uniformity criterion (sets required plenum/compressor outlet pressure)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT ±5% mean / 10% peak-to-peak cold-flow uniformity as the S1a engineering criterion.

answers.question: Gas-path wall recombination policy.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: INERT/low-recombination lining baseline to preserve representative atomic-O fraction as far as practical. Measure the delivered species state and retain catalytic reference coupons/sections; never assume O survival.

answers.question: Exclude silver from wetted parts?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — exclude silver from oxygen/AO-wetted gas-path parts.

answers.question: IF-A3 at the compressor outlet flange, upstream of V0 (needs upstream ICD amendment)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — place IF-A3 at the compressor outlet flange upstream of V0 and amend the upstream ICD accordingly.

answers.question: Gas isolator withstand margin above 350 V (Paschen minimum is crossed; segmented/porous break + gas-filled withstand test proposed).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Design the gas isolator for 350 V continuous operation and perform ~1 kV DC representative-pressure/gas withstand qualification with segmented/porous geometry as appropriate. Do not rely on simple vacuum creepage assumptions across the Paschen region.

answers.question: Anode / distributor material: accept 316L as H-1 baseline (recorded limitation) pending coupons; which candidates on coupons (316L, chromia Ni alloy, alumina-former, Rh, Pt, Cr, IrO2/RuO2, bare W control, graphite); biased (electron-collecting) or floating coupons?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use 316L only as the H-1 engineering baseline. Test both biased and floating coupons across the shortlisted O-resistant candidates so electrochemical/bias effects can be separated. Flight anode material remains open until coupon evidence.

answers.question: O2 cleaning standard (ASTM G93 Level C?) and O2 safety-case ownership.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT ASTM G93 Level C cleaning for O2 service and assign a named oxygen-safety owner before S1a gas operation.

answers.question: Does '< 1.5 kW' apply at bus_power_boundary_v1 and to start-up transients?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — apply <1.5 kW at the spacecraft-DC propulsion-system boundary. Conservatively require startup transients also to remain below 1.5 kW unless the official RFP explicitly permits a transient exception. Use a new A9/v2 boundary without modifying v1.

answers.question: Must a contingency pre-ionizer fit inside the A5 power allocation, or may it use the allocation-to-requirement margin?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED — the downstream ICP is a primary neutralizer candidate, not a contingency pre-ionizer. Its power must fit inside the internal ~1.35 kW design allocation; do not plan to consume the 1.35→1.5 kW margin nominally.

answers.question: Adopt the proposed supply partition (discharge, per-coil magnet, cathode CS-A/CS-B, aux valve/housekeeping, reserved DC port)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT with revision — partition supplies into Hall discharge, per-coil magnet, ICP RF source/matching, ICP collector/bias if required, C1 heater/keeper reference supplies, flow/valve/housekeeping and reserved DC. Every active load gets a bus slot.

answers.question: Spacecraft bus voltage and redundancy policy.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: REGULATED 100 V internal propulsion bus for the breadboard/PPU architecture; keep the spacecraft-input front end configurable until the actual spacecraft bus is specified. Do not claim 100 V is an RFP spacecraft interface requirement.

answers.question: Sequencing SEQ-1: heater off before compressor spin-up and before any pre-ionizer seed?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: REVISE SEQ-1 — sequence to avoid simultaneous peaks, but do not force the C1 heater off before it is safe. For C1, reduce/disable heater only after keeper/discharge is stable per cathode procedure; ICP has no thermionic heater.

answers.question: Procure a flight-representative breadboard discharge supply so eta_d is measured before LOCK-2?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — procure/build a flight-representative breadboard Hall discharge supply so eta_d and transient behavior are measured before LOCK-2.

answers.question: Does the proposed 300 W common allocation include the 50 W controls/thermal?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — the proposed 300 W common allocation includes the 50 W controls/thermal allowance. Treat 300 W as an upper design allocation, not a measured load.

answers.question: Thrust-stand principle.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: TORSIONAL baseline. An alternate stand is allowed only if it meets the same uncertainty, payload, thermal/RF service-line and reinstallation requirements.

answers.question: Maximum moving mass on the stand and its spread across configurations.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Design for at least 25 kg moving payload and characterize the full actual configuration spread. If the flight-representative test article exceeds that, uprate/requalify before procurement rather than trimming hardware to fit the stand.

answers.question: How service lines cross the stand (liquid-metal pots, harp routing, RF/microwave hard line with shams or wireless).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use low-stiffness symmetric harp/slack-loop routing for gas/electrical services and flexible RF coax with matched sham routing. Avoid an uncompensated hard RF line across the moving stage; characterize residual parasitic force.

answers.question: Thrust stand: build / partner (DLR, ESA, Surrey) / buy (AST).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: DUAL PATH — build an in-house engineering torsional stand for development/S1a and use a qualified partner/facility for independent score-bearing/qualification measurements where required. Do not depend on a single purchased black-box stand.

answers.question: Calibration principle and force-traceability class (CSIR-NPL/NABL E2 masses vs other).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use in-situ force calibration with SI-traceable masses/force actuator and lever geometry, verified under relevant ISO/IEC 17025/NABL traceability. Calibrate pre/post block and record drift/hysteresis.

answers.question: Pre-registered S1a u_T acceptance test at 12 mN with max payload and all lines installed?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — preregister the S1a thrust-uncertainty acceptance test at 12 mN with maximum representative moving payload and all service lines installed.

answers.question: Keep 1 % absolute thrust uncertainty gate (published stands show 1.4-2.2 %) or revise?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: KEEP 1% as the design/acceptance target for now. If metrology-only calibration evidence shows it is unattainable, revise before LOCK-2 and before any score-bearing physics data; never relax it after seeing propulsion results.

answers.question: Adopt the kinematic module carrier (module weight off IP-DN, H-1 never unbolted) as the fixture concept?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADOPT, adapted to the new architecture — H-1 remains bolted; the kinematic carrier exchanges C1 reference and ICP-neutralizer modules with repeatable datum control.

answers.question: MFC ranges: 4 overlapping ranges per pure-gas path (20 % FS floor) vs A4 'at least three'; does A4 authorize purchase orders or only quotations?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use 4 overlapping ranges per pure-gas path for quotation/specification; quotations only until H3 approval.

answers.question: MFC principle per gas path.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: THERMAL own-gas-calibrated MFCs as the primary pure-gas approach. Verify mixtures through a traceable transfer/rate-of-rise method; do not use a property-library DP estimate as the primary score-bearing flow standard.

answers.question: Cathode-Xe MFC: cover only 0.05-0.2 mg/s, or also start/diode flows (0.6-0.8 mg/s) - one or two controllers?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: TWO controllers — one high-accuracy 0.05–0.2 mg/s-class C1 steady-flow controller and a separate start/diode-flow controller if 0.6–0.8 mg/s is retained.

answers.question: In-house rate-of-rise calibrator acceptable as S1a primary flow standard, or NABL-certified MFC calibration required?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NABL/ISO-17025 calibration is the primary score-bearing reference. The in-house rate-of-rise system is acceptable as a transfer/verification standard, not as the sole external traceability claim.

answers.question: RGA in the S1a minimum set? If yes, 200 or 300 amu, differential pumping?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — include an approximately 200 amu RGA with differential pumping and species calibration for N2/O2/O-related fragments and Xe. 300 amu is unnecessary unless later diagnostics require heavier species.

answers.question: C-1 pyrometer view (HW-C1-09(b)).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — provide a C1 pyrometer view where line-of-sight exists; keep the tube thermocouple mandatory and never relabel tube temperature as emitter temperature.

answers.question: Exploratory I_d(t) chain to 60 MHz for S1b, or a narrower band recorded as such?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Use the exploratory I_d(t) chain to ~60 MHz if feasible; if hardware bandwidth is lower, declare the measured bandwidth and its anti-alias/transfer function explicitly.

answers.question: Flight telemetry subset (ground vs flight diagnostics) as input to PPU / control-FDIR.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT H2-6 flight telemetry subset and add ICP-specific telemetry: forward/reflected RF power, collector/bias V/I, RF source temperature and neutralizer health/interlock state.

answers.question: Ground radiative sink temperature for the thermal model (facility cryopanel/wall).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: MEASURE actual facility wall/cryopanel radiative sink temperature per run. Use ~300 K chamber walls only as a planning case, never as an unmeasured score-bearing input.

answers.question: Atomic-O representativeness of Phase 3: accept N2 + O2 surrogate with recorded limitation, or add a dedicated atomic-O source?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ADD a dedicated AO source for separate materials/lifetime qualification. Keep N2+O2 as the performance surrogate where necessary, but label it `NO_ATOMIC_O`; never use it as AO-life proof.

answers.question: Sham service lines on the stand in every configuration?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — matched sham service lines in every compared configuration.

answers.question: Witness coupons/holders = non-functional exchangeable items (no new H-1') if B(z) and HW-0 reference unchanged?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — witness coupons/holders remain non-functional exchangeable items if B(z), geometry and HW reference remain within the frozen tolerances.

answers.question: Approve alternative-grade wall sector inserts (N/O wall data, but changes design-representativeness)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES for engineering-only wall-sector studies before score-bearing freeze. Freeze one design-representative wall configuration before S1 and do not mix sector data into the final article unnoticed.

answers.question: Foreign facility (e.g. SITAEL IV10) admissible for score-bearing data (TDF rules, export of H-1, data custody, competitors)?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: CONDITIONAL YES — foreign score-bearing data are admissible only with written TDF/export/IP/data-custody approval and compatible raw-data access. Prefer a domestic facility when it can meet the registered requirements.

answers.question: Request ISRO LPSC facility specifications through official channels before T-PB-MAX is fixed?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — request ISRO/LPSC facility specifications now through official channels before T-PB-MAX is frozen.

answers.question: XPS / light-element EDS: accredited lab mandatory, or academic lab with results labelled semi-quantitative?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: Accredited lab for quantitative score-bearing XPS/EDS where the method/scope supports the elements. Academic-lab work is acceptable as exploratory/semi-quantitative evidence with that limitation stated.

answers.question: Engineering-only S1a in a smaller domestic chamber, score-bearing stages at one facility meeting REQ-FAC-05?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — use a smaller domestic chamber for engineering-only S1a where appropriate and one qualified facility for the score-bearing stages that meets the registered facility requirements.

answers.question: Assign an accountable owner to each of the 17 subsystem rows.
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — Praveen remains accountable system owner. Assign one named responsible engineer to each M16 subsystem row before that row can become READY; until names are available use explicit functional roles, but no row may remain unowned.

answers.question: Accept the scheduler rule (READY/RUNNING/BLOCKED/VERIFIED, one blocking item per row, non-lane-input guard), per-row blocking items and A7 categories?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT the scheduler rule, one-blocker rule, non-lane-input guard, per-row blockers and A7 roll-up categories.

answers.question: Accept the H2-lane-to-row mapping?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT the H2-lane-to-row mapping, then add the new Hall→ICP/A9 lanes without rewriting historical H2 provenance.

answers.question: Direct owning lanes to resolve reconciliation items RC-01..RC-10 (or accept divergences).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: DIRECT owning lanes to resolve RC-01..RC-10. Any accepted divergence must be explicit, justified and versioned rather than left as silent inconsistency.

answers.question: Promote inferred gates (before S1 / HRR / Phase 1) to stated deadlines by mapping them to LOCK-1/LOCK-2?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — promote inferred gates to explicit LOCK-1/LOCK-2 deadlines. Every blocker that can invalidate score-bearing work must have a stated latest decision point.

answers.question: Supply the v2 inputs listed in VALIDATION_PLAN.md (RF coupling, nozzle, Hall-Xe points, compressor, start-up Xe).
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: DO NOT supply or invent the old parallel RF∥Hall v2 inputs. Freeze that branch. Create a new Hall→downstream-ICP validation-input list instead: RF coupling, forward/reflected/absorbed power, electron extraction current, collector potential, neutralization margin, Hall current demand, ICP pressure/flow, startup, erosion and lifetime.

answers.question: Generate hypothesis-grade sec. 45 surfaces from inputs you label ASSUMED_SCREENING_VALUE?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: NO — do not generate hypothesis surfaces by manufacturing `ASSUMED_SCREENING_VALUE` inputs merely to populate plots. Generate surfaces only from explicitly approved screening assumptions with a clear decision purpose, or after real inputs exist.

answers.question: A8 (parallel RF||Hall investigation) stays DRAFT_ARCHITECTURE_HYPOTHESIS, or freeze as an owner decision?
answers.owner_answer_verbatim: KEEP A8 PARALLEL RF∥HALL AS DRAFT/HISTORICAL — do not freeze it. Create a new A9 Hall→downstream 13.56 MHz RF-ICP neutralizer investigation addendum and authorize it as the primary investigation hypothesis, not as a validated/frozen flight architecture.
